verdict.rationale: A CPU vendor can plausibly ship developer SDKs, so the axis applies. The only relevant evidence is a single link heading, "Learn About Ryzen AI Software For Developers", on the general Ryzen family page, and it is not tied to the 9950X3D. Ryzen Master is a tuning utility, not an SDK. Missing for 10: confirmation that the SDK supports this specific processor, SDK documentation (APIs, languages, install), any AI-native or agentic workflow details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.
